Page 96 • Warm-Up

Curtain Raiser: Houses Around the World

Igloo (Snow House)

Found in very cold polar regions (Arctic). Built with blocks of snow to keep people warm inside.

Stilt House (House on Stilts)

Found in rainy or flooded areas near rivers. Built on tall wooden poles to stay dry and safe from water.

Classroom Discussion: Why do people build different houses? Because nature and weather shape how we live — just like Dorothy's cellar in the Land of the Winds!

Activity 12 • Page 113

Dorothy's Diary Entry

1800 May 20, Tuesday

I can’t forget this day. Oh! We were so afraid, Totto and myself. I thought we were about to die. My house flew over the valleys, streets, mountains and so on. I held Totto in my hands, closing my eyes. Suddenly, I heard a sound. Our house landed on a beautiful land. It was the land of the Munchkins. I saw some strange people there. They were very short. My house landed on a wicked witch and she died on the spot. The Munchkins became so happy. They celebrated their freedom. They invited me to dance with them, but I wished to return to my village. The Wizard of Oz, the magician, helped us. Totto and I reached home safely. I met my uncle and aunt. I became so relaxed and happy.
